Key FeaturesDesigner: John Borg (artwork by Markus Rothkranz).Gameplay: 3-ball multiball, dot matrix display, and deep modes including trivia and video features.Iconic Hardware: Features a mechanical handle on the front of the cabinet to adjust the Death Star, as well as an animated R2-D2 figure. The internal cabinet area houses a single-level playfield packed with interactive elements from the original film trilogy:The Death Star: A large, central spinning globe target that splits open to lock balls and trigger the 3-ball Multiball mode.R2-D2: A physical, motorized robotic figurine on the upper-left side that moves up, down, and rotates.Mechanical Targets: Features 2 flippers, 4 pop bumpers, 2 scoops, and a 3-bank set of drop targets.

New Gameplay: * Aliens that Split: Certain crab invaders split into two separate shapeshifting units when hit. * Special UFOs: A blinking UFO appears with a random vulnerability state and point values, while later UFOs drop reinforcements. * Save Initials: High score tracking allows players to save their initials for the first time in the series. * Cutscenes: Short animations play between stages showing defeated invaders escaping or sending SOS signals. Power supply, monitor and logic boards have been recapped and tested. Original color CRT. Cabinet is clean and in good condition. No restoration work has been on the cabinet. Coin switch added for freeplay.

ads.author: Warren Dietrich
ads.title: Die Hard by SEGA full size Arcade Game
ads.description: Rare collectible, price is negotiable and will deliver and set up for the right offer. Great for a business or collection or just for fun. Die Hard By SEGA is A 3-D side-scrolling fighting game based on the movie "Die Hard". Die Hard Arcade was produced by Sega in 1996. Sega released 594 machines in our database under this trade name, starting in 1960. Sega is based in Japan. Each SWAT member must fight every criminal and machine that they come across by punching them, kicking them as well as using various weapons and objects that they can get their hands on including handguns, machine guns, missile launchers, anti-tank cannons, knives, sticks, fireaxes, spray cans, pepper shakers, steel pipes, brooms, bottles and so on. Players can also pick up magazines for handguns and machine guns for extra ammuntion as well as health units for extra health. Also, on some sequences, players must press the Punch button, Kick button or Jump button or move the joystick in a specific direction in order to successfully get past certain enemies or obstacles. If either of the SWAT members fail on those sequences where they are supposed to punch or kick down those enemies, they will have to fight them in hand-to-hand combat.The SWAT members can also attack enemies when grabbing them and they can also arrest them when they grab them by pushing either the Punch or Kick button twice but only if the SWAT member has a handgun. When the SWAT members finally confront the crime boss, they will have to face him twice first in the office and then on the rooftop. On the rooftop, he will be armed with swords and more difficult to hurt. After, you defeat the crime boss for the second time, The President's daughter is rescued. If only one player is in the game, the girl just says "Thank You!" and the game ends. But if two players are in the game, after the girl says "Thank You!", she will want one of the SWAT members to become her new bodyguard as a thanks for rescueing her, so each player will have to fight each other until one of them is defeated and whoever wins will become the girl's new bodyguard but if time runs out, it will be a draw and the girl will be undecided about which SWAT member she wants for her new bodyguard. The game ends afterwards, regardless of the results.

ads.author: William Scott Kimble
ads.title: Chewlix (Viewlix clone) sit down modern arcade cabinets x2
ads.description: FOR SALE: Blue and Black and red and black Chewlix (Chinese made Veiwlix sit down modern arcade cabinets). This is an earlier gen model that mirrors a Vewlix in almost every way. Asking $1650.00 each or $3000.00 for both I have removed almost all of the Chinese wiring and rewired it. The coin mech system is present and does work but, is not wired up because I never had any use for it. All fans in the cabinet have been replaced with Noctua silent fans. Speakers and sound amplifier are the original ones that came with it and have always sound good to me. Cabinet is set up for pure JVS enjoyment .. not JAMMA at all. There are ways to build a device that would convert all of the JAMMA signals to JVS but I am not including one in this sale. The monitors are the same one that comes with it originally. Its a flat panel 1080p with inputs for VGA and HDMI. It comes with a Sega 837-14572 JVS - 8 button JVS. The control panel is wired to light up (buttons and move panel light up) and includes all Sanwa components. Picture does not show the additional wiring for the button lights. However the buttons do light up also. The coin ash tray, tokens and magnetic coin insert are included (red set for the red cab and a blue set for the blue cab). Includes a custom CNC built sub panel that has two (2) usb plug ins, Sound control knob (uses RCA jacks) and six (6) mini buttons for various stuff. (see picture). Keys are included. It comes with a full Street Fight IV Ultra art set. Marquee is sandwiched between two pieces of plexi and it lights up also. Both cabinets are built Exactly the same just one is blue and black (Tekken artwork) and one is red and black (Street Fighter artwork). Require almost zero work. Install the JVS compatible system and off you go. They also make converters that make it to where you can install a PC or a game console. These require additional set up but are not to hard to figure out. However, it also DOES NOT come with a system inside. That would be a separate conversation as I have the following systems available/ Two (2) Heavy modified Taito Type X3 One (1) Modified Namco 246 One (1) Modified Namco 256 One (1) Full SNK Neo Geo motherboard, wiring, memory card, and sound board from a cabinet and yellow Neo Geo MVS multi cart Like I said there is NO syetm included with the cabinet sales. Those would be a side DM discussion. The bad news. I would prefer local pickup in Savannah, GA area However for the right price I may be encouraged to take a trip someone where fairly close (within 200 miles). Shipping is not an option as I do not have the time or patience to deal with it. I am completely getting out of arcades and these were the last items I have. All sales are final. I do not provide tech support anymore. Buyers remorse is not my problem, especially if you get in trouble with your wife

ads.author: Rob Schoonmaker
ads.title: Gate Of Doom 1990 Full Size Stand Up Arcade Game
ads.description: Gate of Doom, known in Japan as Dark Seal (ダークシール), is a hack 'n slash game developed by Data East and released in 1990 for arcades. Gate of Doom is a hack 'n slash game which uses a top-down, isometric perspective. Players can choose between four different characters, each with their own characteristics and abilities. The player can move and attack in eight directions, as well as unleash a powerful spell once its accumulated enough magic power. Much like in Karnov, the player can pick between available spells by tapping the joystick left and right. Levels are filled with enemies and traps, as well as treasure chests which the player can open to obtain various items and power-ups which give passive boosts to the character.

ads.author: Rob Schoonmaker
ads.title: Die Hard Full Size Stand Up Arcade Game
ads.description: A 3-D side-scrolling fighting game based on the movie "Die Hard". Die Hard Arcade was produced by Sega in 1996. Sega released 594 machines in our database under this trade name, starting in 1960. Sega is based in Japan. Each SWAT member must fight every criminal and machine that they come across by punching them, kicking them as well as using various weapons and objects that they can get their hands on including handguns, machine guns, missile launchers, anti-tank cannons, knives, sticks, fireaxes, spray cans, pepper shakers, steel pipes, brooms, bottles and so on. Players can also pick up magazines for handguns and machine guns for extra ammuntion as well as health units for extra health. Also, on some sequences, players must press the Punch button, Kick button or Jump button or move the joystick in a specific direction in order to successfully get past certain enemies or obstacles. If either of the SWAT members fail on those sequences where they are supposed to punch or kick down those enemies, they will have to fight them in hand-to-hand combat.The SWAT members can also attack enemies when grabbing them and they can also arrest them when they grab them by pushing either the Punch or Kick button twice but only if the SWAT member has a handgun. When the SWAT members finally confront the crime boss, they will have to face him twice first in the office and then on the rooftop. On the rooftop, he will be armed with swords and more difficult to hurt. After, you defeat the crime boss for the second time, The President's daughter is rescued. If only one player is in the game, the girl just says "Thank You!" and the game ends. But if two players are in the game, after the girl says "Thank You!", she will want one of the SWAT members to become her new bodyguard as a thanks for rescueing her, so each player will have to fight each other until one of them is defeated and whoever wins will become the girl's new bodyguard but if time runs out, it will be a draw and the girl will be undecided about which SWAT member she wants for her new bodyguard. The game ends afterwards, regardless of the results.

ads.author: Joshua Beecham
ads.title: Arcade Cabinet Project - Cabinet Shell and other parts - $200
ads.description: Empty arcade cabinet shell. Perfect restoration project for an arcade enthusiast, retro gamer, or father-and-son build. The cabinet was built from scratch using 3/4" MDF and includes: 32" portrait-mounted TV with Lexan bezel Marquee fluorescent light Cabinet shell The TV has older inputs including VGA and DVI, and may also have HDMI. Please note: the cabinet has been stored on a screened porch for several years and is dusty. It will need cleaning and some refurbishment before being put back into service. I originally built this for myself and planned to build another one someday, so I removed many of the reusable components when I retired it. It worked perfectly when I disassembled it all. We can some testing from my back porch if you want. Cabinet shell + TV + marquee light: $50 or make offer Optional components available separately: Mini-fridge - $35 Fits perfectly in the bottom of the cabinet. Holds roughly 18-24 cans. Speakers and Amplifier - $25 Generic car speakers and cheap amp. Nothing fancy, but they sounded great in the cabinet. Control Panel - $100 This was the most labor-intensive part of the build. Includes: 12 quality arcade buttons Dual joysticks Trackball Mini-PAC Opti USB controller The Mini-PAC Opti alone sells for around $69 new. The trackball has a cracked plastic piece that will need repair or replacement. Arcade PC - $30 Windows XP machine configured to boot directly into a MAME front end. The hardware itself isn't particularly valuable, but the software setup and configuration took significant time. You could also replace it with a Raspberry Pi running RetroPie or another arcade emulator solution. Pricing Summary Cabinet + TV + marquee light: $50/make offer Mini-fridge: $35 Speakers + amp: $25 Control panel: $100 Arcade PC: $30 Take everything for $200. or make offer The cabinet itself priced low because I need the space. The accessories are the parts I'd originally planned to keep for a future build, but my wife would be thrilled if they disappeared too. Pickup is only available between 6pm and 9pm weekdays and most anytime next weekend. No delivery. You will need your own truck or SUV. I expect this to be gone after Sunday July 26th. This is less of an arcade machine and more of a starting point if you want to *make* one. I offer no guarantees or support.
